content:
Maria (CS): Quick heads-up — SiennaMed (pilot customer) is going live next Wed. They requested: add ap-southeast-1 region, add IP allowlist, and a temporary rate increase for a 3-hour launch window. Also flagged as potential renewal risk (contract up in ~60d). Need help coordinating infra+enablement. Details below.

Alex (Infra): Copy. Can you paste IPs + expected peak RPS and model(s)? Also do they need Dedicated or hosted?

Maria (CS): IPs:
```
52.18.32.101
34.87.21.45
13.250.10.9
```
Estimated peak: ~120 RPS sustained for 3h (burst to 180 RPS for first 15m). Using hosted inference, model: rdx-large-open (testing). Not Dedicated yet — want to try hosted first. :rocket:

Sam (Ops): Hosted should be fine but need temporary rate window + route to ap-southeast-1. I'll pre-allocate burst capacity. Can you open a SC ticket for quota bump so we have audit trail?

Maria (CS): Done — ticket #SC-8792 created with the details and SLA note. pinging here for visibility.

Alex (Infra): On it. I'll add the IPs to the allowlist for ap-southeast-1 and add a rate profile: baseline 120 RPS, burst 200, window 2026-03-24T14:00Z -> 2026-03-24T17:00Z. Will post config snippet when applied.

deploy-bot: allowlist updated for customer_id:sienna-med environment:prod region:ap-southeast-1 by Alex (Infra)

Alex (Infra): Config snippet:
```
customer: sienna-med
region: ap-southeast-1
allowlist:
  - 52.18.32.101
  - 34.87.21.45
  - 13.250.10.9
rate_profile:
  baseline_rps: 120
  burst_rps: 200
  start: 2026-03-24T14:00Z
  end: 2026-03-24T17:00Z
```

Elaine (AE): FYI I'm scheduling the enablement session for Tue 10:00 PT and will include a renewal check-in. Maria please share key stakeholders.

Maria (CS): Sharing contact list now via DM. Thanks everyone — will follow up after launch with feedback and logs. :thumbsup:
